meta.title: Web-protection internal/trusted-source exemption — production fix acceptance (v1.3.43)

root_cause: Web protection auto-banned Docker gateway 172.18.0.1 (reason=auto:web_rate_limit) — Caddy health checks from host arrive as that private IP after NAT; every probe got ip_banned 429 -> Caddy removed both upstreams -> public 503.
fix: service/web_protection_tracker.go: isWebProtectionTrustedSource() — loopback/link-local/private ranges (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16 covers Docker gateway 172.18.0.1) + configurable IPAllowlist fully exempt from rate-limit and auto-ban (still counted for aggregation)
frontend: web-protection settings tab 'IP allowlist' textarea; i18n 7 languages missing=0
tests: go build/vet PASS; go test ./service/ -run TestWebProtection + ./middleware/ PASS
web typecheck + build PASS; vitest web-protection + i18n 4/4 PASS; i18n:sync 7 languages missing=0
